title: Love Carries The Heavier Half
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: Love is not perfect 50-50 accounting; it is noticing when one person's half has become heavier and carrying the small task before the feeling has to become a whole case.
emotional_arc: 50-50 anti-ideal -> Aachu's tired rehne-do proof -> paani as concrete receipt -> Zuv notices before counting -> heavier-half love thesis
source_story_summary: Love is not always 50-50. Daily nok-jhok over tiny things like paani or chores is not really about the task. Aachu says rehne do and makes a small case out of the empty bottle because she wants to feel noticed before asking twice. Zuv does not debate whose turn it was; he notices before counting, fills the bottle, and carries the heavier half for today.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in a soft hand-drawn flat vector / desi storybook illustration style matching the supplied reference carousel examples. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but with the richer model-native handwritten text, faces, outfits, and brandmark composition shown in the style references. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear visual idea. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

concept_selection.source: Golden Theme variant tournament against Calm Enough For Your Chaos first principles and Layer E story-selling cards.
concept_selection.selector_verdict: Winner keeps the creator-preferred 50-50 thought while repairing the advice risk: the premise is fairness versus felt care, Aachu's proof is a tiny domestic irritation that reveals the hidden wish to be noticed, Zuv's role is active noticing before counting, and the final thesis is tender enough to send.
concept_selection.calm_enough_for_chaos_alignment: Preserves the gold carousel machine: universal anti-ideal -> expressive Aachu proof -> Zuv's calm active care -> tender acceptance thesis, while rotating away from repeated chaos/home language.

candidates.name: The Heavier Half
candidates.universal_truth: Love is not perfect accounting; it is noticing when someone's half has become heavier today.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's small rehne-do irritation carries the tiredness of having to notice everything first.
candidates.concrete_proof: The empty water bottle becomes the receipt, but not the premise.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv does not debate whose turn it was; he notices and acts before the moment becomes a case.

candidates.name: Noticed Before Asked
candidates.universal_truth: Fifty-fifty sounds fair until someone has to ask for the same small thing twice.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's visible annoyance is the softer wish to be noticed sooner.
candidates.concrete_proof: The bottle stays empty again, turning a small task into a recognizable couple scene.
candidates.zuv_role: He fills it without speeches or scorekeeping.

candidates.name: She Did Not Want Help
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes help is not the need; being seen before asking is the need.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu says rehne do, but the feeling underneath is please notice the room with me.
candidates.concrete_proof: A small domestic mess, an empty bottle, and her expressive face create the proof.
candidates.zuv_role: He reads the hidden request and starts quietly.
candidates.tender_thesis: He did not help because she asked; he helped because he saw.

candidates.name: The Invisible List
candidates.universal_truth: Not every half feels fair when one person is carrying the list nobody sees.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu remembers sab kuch: bottle, socks, salt, tiny plans, tiny resets.
candidates.concrete_proof: A few simple home details show the invisible load without becoming a chore inventory.
candidates.zuv_role: He starts learning the invisible list instead of waiting to be assigned.

candidates.name: No Ledger Love
candidates.universal_truth: Marriage is not a ledger when love is trying to protect softness, not win math.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu turns one tiny imbalance into affectionate courtroom energy.
candidates.concrete_proof: One sock or one glass becomes Exhibit A.
candidates.zuv_role: He does the tiny thing smiling instead of arguing the score.
